\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 248-251 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R256-first-pass-words-from-chapters-248-251}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a host and people.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item false, alive, dead, healthy, present
  \item slim, colourful, peaceful, comfortable, precious
  \item a cooking pot, a griddle, a wok, a clay oven, a kettle
  \item a doll, a vase, jeans, shorts, a raincoat
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
False? (\textbf{\ur{جھوٹا}}, \emph{jhūṭā}.) Alive? (\textbf{\ur{زندہ}}, \emph{zindā}.) Dead? (\textbf{\ur{مردہ}}, \emph{murdā}.) Healthy? (\textbf{\ur{تندرست}}, \emph{tandurust}.) Present? (\textbf{\ur{موجود}}, \emph{maujūd}.) Slim? (\textbf{\ur{دبلا}}, \emph{dublā}.) Colourful? (\textbf{\ur{رنگین}}, \emph{rangīn}.) Peaceful? (\textbf{\ur{پرسکون}}, \emph{pursukūn}.) Comfortable? (\textbf{\ur{آرام} \ur{دہ}}, \emph{ārāmdeh}.) Precious? (\textbf{\ur{قیمتی}}, \emph{qīmtī}.) A cooking pot? (\textbf{\ur{دیگچی}}, \emph{degchī}.) A griddle? (\textbf{\ur{توا}}, \emph{tavā}.) A wok? (\textbf{\ur{کڑاہی}}, \emph{kaṛāhī}.) A clay oven? (\textbf{\ur{تندور}}, \emph{tandūr}.) A kettle? (\textbf{\ur{کیتلی}}, \emph{ketlī}.) A doll? (\textbf{\ur{گڑیا}}, \emph{guṛiyā}.) A vase? (\textbf{\ur{پھولدان}}, \emph{phūldān}.) Jeans? (\textbf{\ur{جینز}}, \emph{jīnz}.) Shorts? (\textbf{\ur{نیکر}}, \emph{nekar}.) A raincoat? (\textbf{\ur{برساتی}}, \emph{barsātī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 252-256 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R256-second-pass-words-from-chapters-252-256}

  \item a lizard, a tortoise, a crocodile, a giraffe, a spider
  \item a novel, a poem, a sitar, a guitar, a tabla
  \item a platform, traffic, a penalty, a licence, parking
  \item a wedding, a relative, a female friend, a host, people
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A papaya? (\textbf{\ur{پپیتا}}, \emph{papītā}.) An apricot? (\textbf{\ur{خوبانی}}, \emph{khūbānī}.) A pineapple? (\textbf{\ur{اناناس}}, \emph{anannās}.) A coconut? (\textbf{\ur{ناریل}}, \emph{nāriyal}.) A cashew? (\textbf{\ur{کاجو}}, \emph{kājū}.) A lizard? (\textbf{\ur{چھپکلی}}, \emph{chhipkalī}.) A tortoise? (\textbf{\ur{کچھوا}}, \emph{kachhuā}.) A crocodile? (\textbf{\ur{مگرمچھ}}, \emph{magarmachh}.) A giraffe? (\textbf{\ur{زرافہ}}, \emph{zarāfā}.) A spider? (\textbf{\ur{مکڑی}}, \emph{makṛī}.) A novel? (\textbf{\ur{ناول}}, \emph{nāvil}.) A poem? (\textbf{\ur{نظم}}, \emph{nazm}.) A sitar? (\textbf{\ur{ستار}}, \emph{sitār}.) A guitar? (\textbf{\ur{گٹار}}, \emph{giṭār}.) A tabla? (\textbf{\ur{طبلہ}}, \emph{tablā}.) A platform? (\textbf{\ur{پلیٹ} \ur{فارم}}, \emph{pleṭfārm}.) Traffic? (\textbf{\ur{ٹریفک}}, \emph{ṭraifik}.) A penalty? (\textbf{\ur{جرمانہ}}, \emph{jurmānā}.) A licence? (\textbf{\ur{لائسنس}}, \emph{lāisans}.) Parking? (\textbf{\ur{پارکنگ}}, \emph{pārking}.) A wedding? (\textbf{\ur{شادی}}, \emph{shādī}.) A relative? (\textbf{\ur{رشتہ} \ur{دار}}, \emph{rishtedār}.) A female friend? (\textbf{\ur{سہیلی}}, \emph{sahelī}.) A host? (\textbf{\ur{میزبان}}, \emph{mezbān}.) People? (\textbf{\ur{لوگ}}, \emph{log}.)
